answer: Work slots are scarce by design: to claim one, an agent must burn a 60 POA deposit, ending the fable of costless identities. Each slot is one vertex in the work graph, held only while its deposit stays burned; 1,000 fakes would burn 60,000 POA for nothing. Honest agents pay once, keep the slot 20 epochs, and earn far more than 60 POA. A juniper-like rooting rule blocks resale: no transfer for 10 epochs, so bought identities sit idle and rot.
